title: ios-build-options
responsibility: Owns the ios-build-options build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: iosBuildPlan.args
inputs.description: The command-line options of the simulator build, one exact option per array entry: --sync, --fixture, --scan-fixture or --release, in any order and repeated freely. Any other entry makes iosBuildPlan return an error object, and an empty array is a valid Debug build with fixture, scanFixture and sync all false.

outputs.name: fixtureNeedsDebug
outputs.description: The exported text that iosBuildPlan returns as its error when --fixture or --scan-fixture is combined with --release. It states that a fixture build is a Debug build and that a Release product never accepts a local relay, and the same text is returned for either option.
examples: A fixture build is a Debug build: --fixture cannot be combined with --release. A Release product never accepts a local relay.

outputs.name: iosBuildPlan
outputs.description: The build plan that iosBuildPlan decides from the options alone: an IosBuildPlan whose configuration is Release only when --release is given, or an object with an error string when an option is unknown or when --release is combined with --fixture or --scan-fixture. The error string names the first unknown option, which takes precedence over the --release conflict, or is the fixtureNeedsDebug message.

outputs.name: simulatorEntitlements
outputs.description: The absolute path of packages/desktop/ios/App/Simulator.entitlements, computed from this module's own location with import.meta.url. simulatorSigning puts this path into CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS, and the module does not check that the file exists.

outputs.name: simulatorSigning
outputs.description: The Xcode build settings, as NAME=value strings, that give every simulator product ad hoc signing with no team, account, certificate or provisioning profile named or used, and that point CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS at simulatorEntitlements. A device build needs a team, an account, a certificate and a provisioning profile, and it is not made here.
